name: trading-floor-engine
description: Engine kuant + backtester futures (rule-based) untuk Trading Floor

scripts.bot:stop: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir=path.join(process.env.OFFICE_DIR||'office','execution');fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'STOP'),new Date().toISOString());console.log('Kill switch dibuat — bot akan berhenti di tick berikutnya.')"
scripts.bot:reset-day: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir=path.join(process.env.OFFICE_DIR||'office','execution');fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'DAY_RESET'),new Date().toISOString());console.log('Batas rugi harian dihitung ulang mulai sekarang (hanya untuk hari ini, WIB). Besok kembali normal.')"
scripts.bot:status: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const f=path.join(process.env.OFFICE_DIR||'office','execution','state.json');console.log(fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'Belum ada state (bot belum pernah jalan).')"
